text: { "answer": "Based on the available documentation, MangoDB persists writes to disk through file-based storage operations. The system uses asynchronous write operations to save document data to JSON files. Each collection maintains its data in persistent storage files that are read and written during database operations. The writeDocuments method handles the actual persistence of document arrays to disk storage. The implementation ensures data durability through file system operations that commit changes to permanent storage." }
